function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live clock data. You might check a reliable world‑time website or your device’s clock set to Eastern Time (US & Canada) to find the current time in New York City.

According to policy, we cannot fabricate or guess. We should use the function to get the current time? There's no function for time. But we can approximate using known timezone offset. But it's better to respond that we don't have real-time data. The policy says we should not provide inaccurate info. So we should say we don't have real-time data.
